title: The Latest: But Is It Impeachable?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统有一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，简直完美。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院将推进正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: The House Committee on the Judiciary will come to order.
sentences.zh: 众议院司法委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: Without objection, the chair is authorized to declare recesses of the committee at any time.
sentences.zh: 如果没有异议，主席有权在任何时候宣布委员会休会。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, you're serving the right to object.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，您保留了提出异议的权利。

sentences.en: Objections noted.
sentences.zh: 异议已记录。

sentences.en: It's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: The latest is that the House Judiciary Committee has picked up the impeachment inquiry from the
sentences.zh: 最新消息是，众议院司法委员会已经从情报委员会

sentences.en: Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 手中接管了弹劾调查。

sentences.en: The impeachment inquiry has moved back to the House Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 弹劾调查已交回众议院司法委员会。

sentences.en: And as we begin a review of these facts, the president's pattern of behavior becomes clear.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始审查这些事实时，总统的行为模式就变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, they brought four constitutional law professors to help them figure out whether
sentences.zh: 周三，他们请来了四位宪法法学教授来协助弄清楚

sentences.en: President Trump committed an impeachable offense when he pressured Ukraine to open investigations into his political rivals.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统向乌克兰施压要求调查其政治对手的行为是否构成了可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: I will now introduce today's witnesses.
sentences.zh: 我现在介绍今天的证人。

sentences.en: And the three witnesses called by Democrats, Noah Feldman from Harvard.
sentences.zh: 民主党召集的Константин三位证人中，有来自哈佛大学的诺亚·费尔德曼。

sentences.en: Professor Feldman has authored seven books.
sentences.zh: 费尔德曼教授著有七本书。

sentences.en: Pam Carlin from Stanford.
sentences.zh: 来自斯坦福大学的帕姆·卡林。

sentences.en: She is the co-author of several leading case books.
sentences.zh: 她是多本权威案例集的合著者。

sentences.en: Michael Gerhart from the University of North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 来自北卡罗来纳大学的迈克尔·格哈特。

sentences.en: Is the Burton Craig Distinguished Professor of Jurisprudence?
sentences.zh: 他是伯顿·克雷格法学杰出教授吗？

sentences.en: Say yes, the president's conduct is impeachable.
sentences.zh: 说对，总统的行为是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: And not only is it impeachable, they say, but it's exactly the kind of behavior that impeachment was designed for.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这不仅是可弹劾的，而且正是弹劾制度专门用来应对的那类行为。

sentences.en: I'd like to focus the panel on the evidence they considered and the findings in the Intelligence
sentences.zh: 我想让小组聚焦于他们所审议的证据以及情报

sentences.en: Committee report that the president solicited the interference of a foreign government,
sentences.zh: 委员会报告中的调查结果，即总统拉拢外国政府

sentences.en: Ukraine, in the 2020 U.S.
sentences.zh: 即乌克兰，干预2020年美国

sentences.en: presidential election.
sentences.zh: 总统大选。

sentences.en: Professor Feldman, did President Trump commit the impeachable high crime and misdemeanor of abuse of power based on that evidence and those findings?
sentences.zh: 费尔德曼教授，根据这些证据和调查结果，特朗普总统是否犯下了滥用职权这一可弹劾的严重罪行和轻罪？

sentences.en: Based on that evidence and those findings, the president did commit an impeachable abuse of office.
sentences.zh: 基于这些证据和调查结果，总统确实犯下了可弹劾的滥用职权罪。

sentences.en: Professor Carlin, same question.
sentences.zh: 卡林教授，同样的问题。

sentences.en: Same answer.
sentences.zh: 同样的回答。

sentences.en: They might have slightly different ways of explaining it, but they're all in agreement.
sentences.zh: 他们解释的方式可能略有不同，但他们的意见完全一致。

sentences.en: And Professor Gerhart, did President Trump commit the impeachable high crime and misdemeanor of abuse of power?
sentences.zh: 格哈特教授，特朗普总统是否犯下了滥用职权这一可弹劾的严重罪行和轻罪？

sentences.en: We three are unanimous.
sentences.zh: 我们三人一致认为。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Now, the fourth witness, the one called by the Republicans, Jonathan Turley of George
sentences.zh: 现在，第四位证人，也就是共和党召集的证人，乔治

sentences.en: Washington University, is the outlier.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿大学的乔纳森·特利是个特例。

sentences.en: I respect my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我尊重我的同事们。

sentences.en: I know all of them.
sentences.zh: 我都认识他们。

sentences.en: And I consider them friends.
sentences.zh: 我视他们为朋友。

sentences.en: And I certainly respect what they have said today.
sentences.zh: 我当然尊重他们今天所说的话。

sentences.en: We have fundamental disagreements.
sentences.zh: 我们存在根本分歧。

sentences.en: He's a legal scholar, but he's also politically savvy.
sentences.zh: 他是一名法律学者，但也深谙政治。

sentences.en: He's been around this process before.
sentences.zh: 他以前经历过这个流程。

sentences.en: He knows how to make a legal point, but in a way that's powerful politically.
sentences.zh: 他知道如何阐述法律观点，但方式具有强大的政治影响力。

sentences.en: And I'd like to start with the issue of bribery.
sentences.zh: 我想从贿赂问题开始。

sentences.en: This statement has been made, not just by these witnesses, but Chairman Schiff and others, that this is a clear case of bribery.
sentences.zh: 不仅是这些证人，还有希夫主席和其他人，都曾发表过这样的声明，认为这是一起典型的贿赂案。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并非如此。

sentences.en: He's saying, I'm here not as a Republican, but as a scholar.
sentences.zh: 他说，我来这里不是作为共和党人，而是作为一名学者。

sentences.en: My personal views of President Trump are as irrelevant to my impeachment testimony as they should be to your impeachment vote.
sentences.zh: 我对特朗普总统的个人看法与我的弹劾证词无关，正如它不应该与你们的弹劾投票相关一样。

sentences.en: Look, I didn't even vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 听着，我甚至都没投特朗普的票。

sentences.en: I'm not a supporter of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我不是特朗普总统的支持者。

sentences.en: I'm concerned about lowering impeachment standards to fit a paucity of evidence and an abundance of anger.
sentences.zh: 我关心的降低弹劾标准是为了迎合匮乏的证据和过剩的愤怒。

sentences.en: He says Trump's telephone call with the president of Ukraine was not perfect.
sentences.zh: 他说特朗普与乌克兰总统的电话并不完美。

sentences.en: It's actually really troubling.
sentences.zh: 实际上这真的很令人不安。

sentences.en: In fact, it might even be impeachable.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它甚至可能是可弹劾的。

sentences.en: I believe this impeachment not only fails to satisfy the standard of past impeachments, but would create a dangerous precedent for future impeachments.
sentences.zh: 我认为这次弹劾不仅不符合过去弹劾的标准，而且会为未来的弹劾开创一个危险的先例。

sentences.en: But there's just not any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有任何证据表明这一点。

sentences.en: He tells the committee, look, if you're impeaching a duly elected president, you've got to be
sentences.zh: 他对委员会说，听着，如果你要弹劾一位合法当选的总统，你必须

sentences.en: sure every fact is nailed down and every definition of the crime that you're trying to accuse him of is narrow and defensible.
sentences.zh: 确保每一个事实都确凿无误，并且你试图指控他的每一项罪名定义都要狭窄且站得住脚。

sentences.en: And Democrats, he's saying, just have not met that bar.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，民主党人根本没有达到这个标准。

sentences.en: We are living in the very period described by Alexander Hamilton, a period of agitated passions.
sentences.zh: 我们正生活在亚历山大·汉密尔顿所描述的那个时期，一个情绪激动的时期。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: You're mad.
sentences.zh: 你们很生气。

sentences.en: The president's mad.
sentences.zh: 总统很生气。

sentences.en: My Republican friends are mad.
sentences.zh: 我的共和党朋友们很生气。

sentences.en: My Democratic friends are mad.
sentences.zh: 我的民主党朋友们很生气。

sentences.en: My wife is mad.
sentences.zh: 我妻子很生气。

sentences.en: My kids are mad.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们很生气。

sentences.en: Even my dog seems mad.
sentences.zh: 甚至连我的狗看起来也很生气。

sentences.en: And Luna's a golden doodle and they don't get mad.
sentences.zh: 露娜是一只金毛涂鸦犬，它们本来是不会生气的。

sentences.en: So we're all mad.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都很生气。

sentences.en: Where has that taken us?
sentences.zh: 这把我们带到了哪里？

sentences.en: Will a slipshod impeachment make us less mad?
sentences.zh: 一场草率的弹劾能让我们不那么生气吗？

sentences.en: Will it only invite an invitation for the madness to follow every future administration?
sentences.zh: 它难道只会招致疯狂继续纠缠每一届未来的政府吗？

sentences.en: That is why this is wrong.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这是错的。

sentences.en: This is interesting because it's not the dominant Republican argument that we've heard so far.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为这并不是我们迄今为止听到的主流共和党论点。

sentences.en: They've essentially said that the president hasn't really done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上一直在说总统其实没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: And so Turley's view here is not in keeping with that.
sentences.zh: 所以特利这里的观点与此不符。

sentences.en: And while it's not clear whether there's a grand strategy here among Republicans if they're somehow pivoting to a new line of argument,
sentences.zh: 虽然目前尚不清楚共和党内部是否存在某种宏大战略，或者他们是否在某种程度上转向了新的论点，

sentences.en: it is clear that they had to have known what Turley was going to say.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，他们事先一定知道特利会说些什么。

sentences.en: And in some ways, they may be acknowledging at this point that their argument that the president did nothing wrong is not actually going to last them throughout this process.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们可能在这个时候承认，他们关于总统没有做错任何事的论点实际上无法支撑他们走完全程。

sentences.en: And it's not going to be enough in the eyes of the public.
sentences.zh: 而且在公众眼中这也远远不够。

sentences.en: In a way, Turley is kind of giving permission to people who are watching and listening to all this to say, hey, look, I don't like what the president did.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，特利等于是在对所有观看和聆听这一切的人说，嘿，你看，我确实不喜欢总统做的事。

sentences.en: It wasn't great.
sentences.zh: 那可不太妙。

sentences.en: But impeaching him for it is too much.
sentences.zh: 但因此弹劾他就太过分了。

sentences.en: It's too extreme.
sentences.zh: 太极端了。

sentences.en: That's essentially what he's saying.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他想表达的。

sentences.en: And in doing that, he's speaking to a certain segment of the public that may be open to the idea of considering impeachment,
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他正在与公众中的特定群体对话，这个群体可能对考虑弹劾持开放态度，

sentences.en: but actually not totally comfortable with going through with it.
sentences.zh: 但实际上对真正走到那一步并不是完全安心。

sentences.en: And that is a crucial segment for Republicans who know how this vote is going to turn out.
sentences.zh: 对于那些深知这次投票最终结果的共和党人来说，这是一个至关重要的群体。

sentences.en: But they also have to worry about how the public views this, how the voters view this.
sentences.zh: 但他们也必须担心公众如何看待这件事，选民如何看待这件事。

sentences.en: And they may want to be able to say, you know, when it came down to it,
sentences.zh: 他们可能希望能够说，你知道的，到了关键时刻，

sentences.en: we didn't just wrap the president in a big bear hug and close our eyes and close our ears and ignore all the evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有只是给总统一个热烈的熊抱，然后闭上眼睛、捂住耳朵，对所有证据视而不见。

sentences.en: We cared about the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 我们在乎宪法。

sentences.en: We cared about the process.
sentences.zh: 我们在乎程序。

sentences.en: But we just didn't feel like what Trump did was impeachable.
sentences.zh: 但我们只是觉得特朗普做的事还没达到可弹劾的程度。

sentences.en: And that's the latest from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这就是华盛顿传来的最新消息。

sentences.en: We know the Judiciary Committee is going to have a hearing at some point next week, but we don't know when.
sentences.zh: 我们知道司法委员会将在下周的某个时候举行听证会，但具体时间未定。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《电线切割机秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用上或在你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《电线切割机秀》。
